Interface BaseMotor

All Known Subinterfaces:
DCMotor, EncoderMotor, RegulatedMotor
All Known Implementing Classes:
PFMotor, PoweredUpMotor, RcxMotor
public interface BaseMotor
A motor that runs forward or backward until it is stopped. Implementations are primitive and allocation-free, so a motor handle can be used in the board program.

    Turns the motor in reverse until stop() or flt() is called.
    void
    flt()
    Removes all power so the motor coasts to a stop, unlike stop(), which holds it in place.
    void

    Turns the motor forward until stop() or flt() is called.
    boolean
    isMoving()
    Returns true while the motor is commanded to move, otherwise false.
    void
    stop()
    Halts the motor at once and resists further movement, unlike flt(), which lets it coast.
